tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify whether a payment settled and what evidence links it to agents, jobs, and authority.

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: Explain a transaction as a structured evidence-backed narrative.

tools.name: lookup_job
tools.description: Look up an ERC-8183 job and linked payments/outcomes.

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: Return observed activity for an agent identity or wallet (partial in Wave A).

tools.name: check_authority
tools.description: Assess mandate and task authority for an action. May return authorization_evidence_missing until adapters exist.

tools.name: trace_task
tools.description: Trace a task execution. Returns coverage gaps until task adapters exist.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search providers by structured performance filters. Limited until graph history accumulates.
